up: For assay CHEMBL1613769, return the exact activity values and compound structures. Provide the following columns: compound ChEMBL ID, compound name, activity type (e.g., IC50, Ki), exact activity value, activity units, and canonical SMILES. Include only rows where the activity relation is exact ('=').
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, md.pref_name AS compound_name, a.standard_type AS activity_type, a.standard_value AS exact_activity_value, a.standard_units AS activity_units, cs.canonical_smiles FROM assays ass JOIN activities a ON ass.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1613769' AND a.standard_relation = '=' AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL
